mermaid.min.js is the existing Mermaid browser bundle previously shipped at
site_libs/quarto-diagram/mermaid.min.js by this repository's Quarto build.
The original bundle and its embedded third-party license notices are preserved.
Hugo serves this bundle locally; Quarto is not required to build or run the site.
Upstream project and MIT license: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid
